get.description: Requires reminders:read. Read an eligible owned personal card’s settings, effective schedule, version, account delivery switch and native queue/provider state. Works for all resource types, including completed cards when explicitly scheduled; archived/trashed cards are unavailable. No device subscriptions are returned. Provider acceptance never verifies phone arrival.

put.description: Requires reminders:write. Create or update a reminder on any eligible owned personal card. schedule supports relative calendar days/weeks at localTime, precise minute/hour offsets, or an absolute RFC3339 instant, with IANA timeZone. Exact-time reminders need no card due date. Explicit schedules override automatic/global timing and freeze defaults, but respect account enabled, per-card disabled and account quiet hours. Supply expectedSettingsVersion from GET and Idempotency-Key for schedule, leadMinutes, remindAt changes; stale versions return409. Repeat the same key/body safely; replay returns current state without overwriting later manual edits. schedule:null returns to account defaults. The legacy disabled/weekly/time body remains compatible and preserves explicit settings if omitted. Cancelling prevents future dispatch but cannot recall an already accepted Push. Resolution is the existing minute cron plus provider/device delay, not exact-to-second.

post.description: Requires courses:read, tasks:read, tasks:write, reminders:read and reminders:write. Ensure an existing assignment has one native reminder card. Uses existing account timezone, lead time, notification opt-in and device subscriptions. A new automatic or legacy lead-based link requires enabled due reminders and a future unfinished task. An explicit schedule requires account notifications enabled; an absolute schedule also supports tasks without deadlines and completed eligible tasks. Preserves existing/manual linked cards and settings. expectedRevision is checked for a new link; repeated calls never create another card. Receipt and Firestore relation are atomic; D1/native scope recovery is durable. Retry the same body and Idempotency-Key, or poll GET after202. No API consumer receives Firebase credentials. Optional leadMinutes applies only to a NEW linked reminder card:4320=72 hours and5760=96 hours. Omitting it preserves account defaults. A reminder time at or before now is rejected. Repeated links never replace a manual override; reminder-settings-conflict means read the existing card reminder and use its version-checked PUT deliberately. Alternatively supply schedule (mutually exclusive with leadMinutes) for the same universal modes. Absolute schedule allows tasks without due dates. After linking, manage the card through GET/PUT/DELETE /reminders/{projectId}. New explicit schedules do not change global defaults.

post.description: Requires courses:read, tasks:read and reminders:write. Request one task-added Push event per owner/task using trusted Wilo task content and only that owner’s registered devices. Respects notification opt-in, quiet hours and hideContent. No free-form message, UID, subscription or destination is accepted. Required Idempotency-Key is scoped to this operation/owner; the same key with different input returns409. A different key still cannot resend the same task event. Keep a stable key; at most32 keys per task. First request checks expectedRevision. Native queue/cron resume partial failures. Unknown provider/network outcomes are not retried automatically (at-most-once attempt/device), avoiding duplicate notifications. Provider acceptance is not proof of display. No new notification opt-in/device enrollment occurs. Optional bypassQuietHours=true requires that API key quiet-hours override permission; otherwise 403 quiet-hours-override-forbidden. False/omitted respects quiet hours. New keys default off. Owner can change the existing key via authenticated account Settings, never this API. Permission is checked again at dispatch; revocation/expiry/deletion restores quiet hours for pending work. To upgrade a deferred event, use an authorized key and a NEW Idempotency-Key with bypassQuietHours=true; the same pending logical event is promoted, not duplicated. Changing a body under an existing key remains 409. Completed events are never resent. Processing events are not promoted mid-dispatch; poll status before retry. Scheduled reminders are unaffected.

bypassQuietHours.description: Explicit immediate-event quiet-hours bypass. Requires the additional owner-managed API key permission and all normal scopes. Does not bypass account opt-out, card exclusion or device withdrawal.
